_doc: Scripted spectator flights. The driver sends `tp <player> x y z yaw pitch` over RCON at rate_hz along the polyline at constant speed, looping when the path is shorter than speed x duration. yaw faces the direction of travel (Minecraft: 0 = +z, 90 = -x).

lobby.note: Spawn -> rotunda -> casino wing -> east pavilion -> water garden -> exedra -> west wing -> bank -> moon gate -> spawn. The island is about 18x18 chunks, so at render distance 12 all of it is loaded before the window starts; this scenario is about drawing the densest built area, not about chunk loading.

survival.note: Taecho village (centre 150,390; wall x 62..224, z 302..486) and the terrain around it. The replica's saved animals are few, so prep-world.py adds a fixed NoAI herd at each waypoint, the same one every run.
